items: 8 oz can artichokes (in brine, not marinated), drained and loosely chopped

ingredients.group: Or, jalapeño version (instead of dill weed)

steps.title: Prep the artichokes
steps.body: Drain and loosely chop **8 oz can artichokes** (in brine, not marinated).

steps.title: Mix the dip
steps.body: Mix the artichokes with **1 cup mayonnaise**, **1 cup sour cream**, **1 cup parmesan cheese**, dill weed to taste and garlic pepper to taste. For the jalapeño version, leave out the dill and mix in **⅓ cup pickled jalapeños** instead.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place in a greased casserole dish and bake at 350°F until hot all the way through, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve hot with crusty bread cubes, pretzels, or crackers. For the jalapeño version, serve with tortilla chips.
